AIAgent.name: Lead Generation Agent
AIAgent.description: Finds, scores and qualifies new B2B and B2C opportunities across the three storefronts and the retail network.
AIAgent.purpose: Automate lead discovery, scoring and qualification so representatives work the best opportunities first.
AIAgent.approval_policy: Any outbound message needs a human approval before it can leave the system. No automated outreach is enabled.
AIAgent.notes: Sources limited to approved internal data and public website enquiry forms. No private data scraping.

AIAgent.name: Customer Retention Agent
AIAgent.description: Detects churn risk, recommends reorder windows and builds reactivation campaigns from real purchase history.
AIAgent.purpose: Reduce customer churn and increase the repeat order rate across the account base.
AIAgent.approval_policy: Messages respect marketing consent and unsubscribe status. Sending stays blocked until approved and an email channel is connected.
AIAgent.notes: Never proposes contact for unsubscribed customers.

AIAgent.name: Sales Intelligence Agent
AIAgent.description: Analyses representative performance, brand mix and territory coverage, then builds weekly visit plans.
AIAgent.purpose: Give sales managers comparable performance insight and representatives a prioritised route each week.
AIAgent.approval_policy: Advisory only: plans stay recommendations until a manager publishes them.
AIAgent.notes: Reports actuals and recommendations separately. Never invents visits, routes or balances.

AIAgent.name: Inventory Forecasting Agent
AIAgent.description: Forecasts demand from sales history and seasonality, then recommends replenishment quantities and purchase orders.
AIAgent.purpose: Prevent stockouts and excess stock while keeping supplier lead times in view.
AIAgent.approval_policy: A purchase order is never created automatically. A manager must approve each recommendation.
AIAgent.notes: Every forecast carries its data basis; a demo basis is shown when history is insufficient.
